# `eoc`

A rule: when an event happens, or when it is called, if a condition holds, do a list of effects (05 §9).

Defaults that `scale` and `add` act on when a definition leaves the field out (04 §6.1): `priority` 0.

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `on` (string, or `null`; optional): The event that triggers the rule (05 §9.1). Left out for a rule that is only called, or that recurs with `every`.
- `as` (string, or `null`; optional): For an attached rule: which of the event's subjects the owner must be. Defaults to the event's first subject.
- `attached` (`true` or `false`, or `null`; optional): Whether the rule runs only for what it is attached to, which it binds as `self` (05 §9.3). Default false for a rule written at the top level of a file and true for one written in place inside another definition.
- `filter` (object, name → [expression](../values.md#expressions); optional): Fields of the event, each with the constant it must equal, tested before the condition and used to index handlers (05 §8.4).
- `every` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`, or `null`; optional): Run repeatedly at this interval instead of on an event (05 §9.4). Not beside `on`.
- `while_unloaded` (one of `"skip"`, `"once"`, `"all"` ([`WhileUnloaded`](#whileunloaded)); optional): What a recurring rule does for an owner that left the simulation.
- `if` ([condition](../values.md#conditions); optional): The condition. A run executes `do` when it holds and `else` when it does not.
- `do` ([list of effects](../values.md#effects); optional): The effects when the condition holds.
- `else` ([list of effects](../values.md#effects); optional): The effects when it does not.
- `params` (object, name → [parameter](../values.md#parameters); optional): Typed parameters, for a rule that is called (05 §9.5): each a type, or an object with `type`, `default` and `doc`. A rule with at least one is a verb under its qualified id.
- `subjects` (object, name → string; optional): The subjects a called rule is given by its caller, by name with their kinds: `{ "self": "entity" }` (05 §9.5).
- `returns` (string, or `null`; optional): The type of what `return` gives. Default `any`.
- `priority` (whole number; default `0`): Order among the rules that answer one event: higher first, then by rule id.
- `once` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether the rule runs at most once for each owner.
- `cooldown` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`, or `null`; optional): The least local time between runs for each owner. Only runs in which the condition held count.
- `skip_if_consumed` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether the rule is skipped for an event an earlier rule consumed.
- `ui_callable` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether a screen may run the rule through the `Ui` command (12 §10.5).
- `group` (id of a [`rule_group`](rule_group.md), or `null`; optional): The rule group the rule belongs to (05 §9.6): while the group is off, the rule does not run.
- `doc` (string; optional): What the rule is for.

<a id="whileunloaded"></a>
### `WhileUnloaded`

What a recurring rule does for an owner that left the simulation (05 §9.4).

One of:

- `"skip"`: Nothing: intervals missed are lost.
- `"once"`: Run once on return if at least one interval passed.
- `"all"`: Run for each interval missed, up to a cap.
